test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

My teacher asked me to keep_____.
solution:
The correct answer is **Quiet.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate option to fill in the blank is Quiet.
 
• Quiet means **making little or no noise**.
 
• Thus the correct answer is Quiet
